title: ResourcePack3000
description: a texture pack that replaces some food with Joyride candy, made for ryan3000 (Ryan Trahan)
body:
# Sorry if there are no updates at all as of late, I'm still playing Deltarune chapter 5 and catching up to ryan3000 :(
## This texture pack simply changes some food items to look like a bag of joyride.
Made from scratch with [Aseprite](https://www.aseprite.org/)

Some make sense, some are changed because they kinda look similar if you think about it lol. More bags and other references to come as I come up with them (it doesn't have to be just Joyride).
